dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは＾＾宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello. :) Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: お待たせいたしました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for waiting.

dialogue.origin: 本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: もう初めていただいて大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: It's fine to begin now.

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、ですが＾＾
dialogue.content: If that’s okay with you. :)

dialogue.origin: はじめに年齢性別今日の相談したいことよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 14、男です。
dialogue.content: I’m a 14-year-old boy.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 最近、好きになった人がいるんですが
dialogue.content: Recently, there's someone I've started to like,

dialogue.origin: 男なんです
dialogue.content: and he's a guy.

dialogue.origin: 恋の相談ですね
dialogue.content: This is about a crush, right?

dialogue.origin: そいつに告ろうかと
dialogue.content: I'm thinking about confessing to him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 男の子同士なんですね
dialogue.content: So, it's between two boys.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのことは同じクラスですか
dialogue.content: Is he in the same class as you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: クラスでなかよしのお友達ですか？
dialogue.content: Are you close friends in class?

dialogue.origin: はい、同じグループです
dialogue.content: Yes, we're in the same group of friends.

dialogue.origin: よく一緒に遊ぶんですか？
dialogue.content: Do you hang out together often?

dialogue.origin: 同じグループなんで、いつも一緒にいる感じです
dialogue.content: Since we’re in the same group, we’re pretty much always together.

dialogue.origin: どんなことして遊ぶことが多いでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you usually do when you hang out?

dialogue.origin: いつも一緒なんですね
dialogue.content: So you’re always together.

dialogue.origin: ただ話したりするかんじで、前はカラオケ行ったり
dialogue.content: We mostly just talk. We've gone to karaoke before.

dialogue.origin: 楽しそうですね。よくカラオケ行くんですか？
dialogue.content: That sounds like fun. Do you go to karaoke often?

dialogue.origin: よくではないです
dialogue.content: Not often.

dialogue.origin: たまに
dialogue.content: Sometimes.

dialogue.origin: 最近はコロナだからあまりしない
dialogue.content: We haven't been doing it much lately because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: 普段はただ話すだけが多いんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So usually you mostly just talk?

dialogue.origin: だいたい遊ぶのは話してます
dialogue.content: Yeah, when we hang out, it’s mostly talking.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 彼女同士も仲が良いんで最近は遠出したりもしました
dialogue.content: Our girlfriends are also good friends, so lately we’ve gone on longer outings together.

dialogue.origin: 今回は友達に告白の相談でよかったですか？
dialogue.content: So, just to confirm, you'd like to talk about confessing to your friend?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 彼女同士？というと
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'girlfriends'?

dialogue.origin: 彼女同士です。相手にも、俺にも彼女がいます
dialogue.content: I mean our girlfriends. He has a girlfriend, and so do I.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お互い彼女もいるけど告白してお付き合いしたいということですか？
dialogue.content: So, even though you both have girlfriends, you want to confess and start dating him?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 友達のままではなｊく
dialogue.content: You don’t want to stay just friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もしお付き合い出来たら彼女さんとはどうするか考えてますか？
dialogue.content: If you were to start dating him, have you thought about what to do about your girlfriend?

dialogue.origin: 別れます
dialogue.content: I would break up with her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 周りの友達に相談されましたか
dialogue.content: Have you talked to any of your other friends about this?

dialogue.origin: いえ、誰にも言ってません
dialogue.content: No, I haven’t told anyone.

dialogue.origin: なかなか相談できないですよね
dialogue.content: It's hard to talk about, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: ネットでは告ると死ぬ結果になるとか書いてあって
dialogue.content: I read online that confessing could have disastrous consequences or something.

dialogue.origin: 告白するならどんな感じでしようとか
dialogue.content: If you were to confess, how might you want to do it…

dialogue.origin: かんがえてますか
dialogue.content: have you given it any thought?

dialogue.origin: わからない、まだそこまでは
dialogue.content: I don't know, I haven't thought that far ahead yet.

dialogue.origin: ネット検索すると悩みますよね
dialogue.content: Searching online can make you worry more, can't it?

dialogue.origin: DMかな、告るなら
dialogue.content: If I were to confess, maybe I'd do it by DM.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 実名でですか
dialogue.content: With your real name?

dialogue.origin: 実名？
dialogue.content: My real name?

dialogue.origin: 勇気がいると思うので告白は
dialogue.content: Confessing takes a lot of courage.

dialogue.origin: 実名でですか、ってどういう意味ですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by, 'with my real name'?

dialogue.origin: 自分の名前でと思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I just meant using your own name.

dialogue.origin: あー、友達とは連絡dmなんです
dialogue.content: Ah, I communicate with my friend via DMs.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ずっと友達でいたらとか色々考えてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It makes you think about all sorts of things, like what would happen if you just stayed friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 告白はしてみないとわからないので
dialogue.content: You won't know unless you try confessing.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That’s true.

dialogue.origin: ですよね
dialogue.content: Right?

dialogue.origin: 失敗した時に学校で居場所なくならないかとか
dialogue.content: I worry that if it goes badly, I might lose my place at school.

dialogue.origin: 不安
dialogue.content: I'm anxious.

dialogue.origin: 告白してみて後悔するかとか考えますよね
dialogue.content: You think about whether you'll regret confessing, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 向こうが気持ち悪がるかなとか
dialogue.content: I worry he might find it gross.

dialogue.origin: 相手の気持ち大事ですよね
dialogue.content: The other person's feelings are important, aren't they?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自分のお気持ちはどうですか
dialogue.content: And what about your own feelings?

dialogue.origin: 好きで告りたいです
dialogue.content: I like him and I want to confess.

dialogue.origin: もう決まっているんではないかなと思うので
dialogue.content: It sounds like you’ve already made up your mind.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I thought so.

dialogue.origin: でも彼女同士も仲良いから、うまくいってもバレそうで
dialogue.content: But our girlfriends are friends too, so even if it went well, I feel like they'd find out.

dialogue.origin: 上手くはいかないんだろうけど
dialogue.content: Not that I think it would go well, though.

dialogue.origin: でしたら尚更言いにくいですよね
dialogue.content: That makes it even harder to say anything, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: だから、黙っておいた方が身の為かなとか
dialogue.content: So I wonder if it's better for me to just keep quiet.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: ずっと一緒に関係をというと
dialogue.content: When you talk about the relationship... you mean long-term?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 確かに今のままのほうがずっと一緒にいられるとおもいます
dialogue.content: It's true that you could probably stay together longer if things stay as they are.

dialogue.origin: フラれるってことですか？
dialogue.content: Are you saying I'll be rejected?

dialogue.origin: もしかしたらとおっしゃって居たので
dialogue.content: You mentioned that it was a possibility, so…

dialogue.origin: 告らず、黙っといた方がいいってこと？
dialogue.content: So you're saying I shouldn't confess and just keep quiet?

dialogue.origin: そんなことはないですよ
dialogue.content: That's not what I'm saying.

dialogue.origin: 告白して
dialogue.content: If you confess,

dialogue.origin: 自分の気持ちに正直になれるならいいと思います
dialogue.content: and can be honest with your feelings, then I think that's a good thing.

dialogue.origin: 向こうには彼女がいるし可能は低いですよねバレたらやっぱりイジメられますか？
dialogue.content: He has a girlfriend, so the chances are low, right? If it gets out, will I really get bullied?

dialogue.origin: 不安な気持ちも大きいとは思いますが
dialogue.content: I imagine your anxiety is very strong, but

dialogue.origin: イジメられて死んだ人もいるって書いてありました、ネットに
dialogue.content: I read online that some people have been bullied to death over this.

dialogue.origin: やっぱりおかしいんですかね
dialogue.content: Is there something wrong with me after all?

dialogue.origin: いじめられるよりも告白したいという気持ちのほうが大きいですか？
dialogue.content: Is your desire to confess stronger than your fear of being bullied?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don’t know.

dialogue.origin: イジメられたくはない
dialogue.content: I don’t want to be bullied.

dialogue.origin: 全然おかしくないですよ
dialogue.content: There’s nothing wrong with you at all.

dialogue.origin: でも気持ちは抑えられない
dialogue.content: But I can't suppress my feelings.

dialogue.origin: いじめられたくはないんですね
dialogue.content: You don't want to be bullied, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That's understandable.

dialogue.origin: イジメられたい人いないと思う…それに、打ち明けるのに勇気いるから、それ責められたら死にたくもなるのわかる
dialogue.content: I don't think anyone wants to be bullied... Plus, it takes courage to open up, so I can understand why someone would want to die if they were condemned for it.

dialogue.origin: どこかでその気持ちを発散するとかできるといいですが
dialogue.content: It would be good if you could vent those feelings somewhere.

dialogue.origin: 匿名でつぶやくとか
dialogue.content: Like posting anonymously online, for example.

dialogue.origin: 匿名では相談したことあります
dialogue.content: I've asked for advice anonymously before.

dialogue.origin: Twitterでも
dialogue.content: On Twitter, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その時のお気持ちはいかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you did that?

dialogue.origin: 世間では表向き肯定されるけど、大人の話なのかなって思った
dialogue.content: Society seems supportive on the surface, but I felt like it's more of a topic for adults.

dialogue.origin: 学生は辞めた方がいいって人ばかりだった…
dialogue.content: Everyone was saying that students should just avoid it…

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: だから怖くなった
dialogue.content: That's why I got scared.

dialogue.origin: 人に言われると余計に怖くてできないですよね
dialogue.content: When other people say that, it makes you even more scared and unable to act, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私でもきっと怖いと思うので
dialogue.content: I'm sure I would be scared too.

dialogue.origin: ネットでつぶやいたり相談で少しでも気持ちがましになるならいいのですが
dialogue.content: If posting or getting advice online helps you feel even a little better, that's a good thing.

dialogue.origin: 友達のままいることも考えたけど、あと何年も偽っていなきゃならないのかと思うと絶望的な気持ちがします
dialogue.content: I've thought about staying just friends, but when I think about having to hide my feelings for years to come, I feel hopeless.

dialogue.origin: 告白して後悔するかしないで後悔するかどちらかを取りたいですか？
dialogue.content: Would you rather regret confessing, or regret not confessing?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね悩むと思います
dialogue.content: That’s understandable. It's a difficult decision, I'm sure.

dialogue.origin: イジメられて存在消されるのはやだし
dialogue.content: I don’t want to be bullied and have my existence erased.

dialogue.origin: それは避けたいですよね
dialogue.content: You'd want to avoid that, right?

dialogue.origin: 好きな気持ちを隠しながらいるのもつらいし
dialogue.content: And it's also painful to hide these feelings.

dialogue.origin: そうだとおもいます
dialogue.content: I'm sure it is.

dialogue.origin: では
dialogue.content: Then,

dialogue.origin: 違う形で軽く伝えるというのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: how about conveying it in a different, lighter way?

dialogue.origin: 違う形？
dialogue.content: A different way?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 例えばですが友達としてめちゃ好きというのもありだとおもいます
dialogue.content: For example, you could say that you really like him as a friend.

dialogue.origin: 言ってます
dialogue.content: I already say that.

dialogue.origin: ふざけてキスしたり
dialogue.content: We even joke around and kiss sometimes.

dialogue.origin: もういってたんですね
dialogue.content: Oh, you already have.

dialogue.origin: いつもじゃないけど、笑いで
dialogue.content: Not always, but as a joke.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってるんですね
dialogue.content: You're really trying, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: ノリで
dialogue.content: Just for fun.

dialogue.origin: 仲は良いので
dialogue.content: We're close, so...

dialogue.origin: 友達にしてみて反応どうですか
dialogue.content: How does your friend react when you do that?

dialogue.origin: 向こうも親友として、一生一緒にいたい的なかんじで
dialogue.content: He says stuff like, as best friends, he wants to be with me forever.

dialogue.origin: いいですね
dialogue.content: That's great.

dialogue.origin: 無人島に一緒にいくならお前とって
dialogue.content: He said if he had to go to a deserted island with one person, it would be me.

dialogue.origin: すごいじゃないですか
dialogue.content: Isn't that amazing?

dialogue.origin: でも、それは恋愛とかじゃないから
dialogue.content: But that's not romantic or anything.

dialogue.origin: そこまではなかなか難しいですよね
dialogue.content: Getting to that point is quite difficult, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: しばらくなかよしの友達では耐えられませんか？
dialogue.content: Can you not bear being just good friends for a while longer?

dialogue.origin: はい…何で相談にきました
dialogue.content: No... that's why I came for counseling.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 後悔しても告白したい気持ちが抑えられないのであれば告白してもいいと思います
dialogue.content: If you can't suppress the desire to confess, even knowing you might regret it, then I think it's okay to do so.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自分の気持ち大事だとおもうので
dialogue.content: Your feelings are important.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談してみてどうでしたか
dialogue.content: How do you feel after our talk today?

dialogue.origin: イジメられたらって考えると不安です
dialogue.content: I feel anxious when I think about the possibility of being bullied.

dialogue.origin: それは大きいですからねどちらとるか悩むと思うので
dialogue.content: That's a huge concern, so I understand that you're struggling with which path to take.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも悩んだらいつでも相談してほしいです
dialogue.content: If you're ever struggling, even a little, please know you can always come and talk.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも気持ちがましになると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I'm glad if you're feeling even a little better.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: またよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.
